scenarios.title: A run branch is classified as run with an integer n
scenarios.notes: Try run-3, run-0, run-12, run-007. Try run-x, run-, run-3-x, run--1. n must be an integer and the row gives no id. The CLI must print the same kind and n.

scenarios.title: A milestone branch is classified as milestone and never swallows e2e tails
scenarios.notes: M-2 is milestone. M-, M-x are null. M-2-e2e and M-2-e2e-api must not be milestone. m-2 is null by default and milestone under {name:lower}.

scenarios.title: An e2e branch is classified as e2e and an e2e-area tail is not
scenarios.notes: M-2-e2e is e2e with id M-2. M-2-e2e-api must not be e2e. M-2-e2e- is null. Check the end anchor with trailing text.

scenarios.title: An e2e-area branch keeps a dashed area whole
scenarios.notes: M-2-e2e-api-v2 gives area api-v2. Try areas a, 0, e2e, v2-api-3, and long areas. The CLI must print the same id and area.

scenarios.title: First-match order holds under prefixed and suffixed formats
scenarios.notes: Run rows 1 to 4 under feature/PROJ-1-{name} and {name}-wip. M-2-e2e-api-wip gives area api. A tail that fits rows 2, 3 and 4 in turn must go to the first matching row.

scenarios.title: Slice, e2e-area and verify branches keep the table's precedence in one call
scenarios.notes: S-fix-M-1-2 is slice. M-1-e2e-api is e2e-area. S-001-v0-http-api-0 is verify with profile http-api, round 0, part 0. Assert all three under the default format.

scenarios.title: Hostile branch tails are refused or classified without crashes
scenarios.notes:
Python $ matches before a trailing newline, so try M-2
, run-3
 and M-2-e2e
. Try unicode digits in run-N and M-N, NUL, control characters, flag-like values, and slashes inside an area (M-2-e2e-a/b). Parse must never raise, and a hostile tail must not gain a kind that a clean tail would not get. Slash in an area keeps the S-007 behavior per ADR-20261009-173303-decision-judge-S-008-a88a, so note it and do not fail on it.

tools.purpose: Call parse in batch through pycall.py with generated tails and formats.
Run branches.py parse in a scratch repo and compare kind, n, id and area with the function result.
Feed hostile tails (newline, unicode digits, NUL, flag-like values) to parse.

riskReason: The slice adds tests only, but a precedence mistake in parse would misclassify milestone and e2e branches in the loop.
notes: S-007 built all parse rows, so the slice changes no product code. Verification probes the existing rows at their boundaries. Limits, data, async and i18n do not apply.
